sql.query: UPDATE tbl_workflows w INNER JOIN tbl_event_milestones m ON m.id=:milestoneId AND m.tenantId=w.tenantId AND (m.isActive=1 OR m.id=w.currentMilestoneId) SET w.currentMilestoneId=m.id,w.rowVersion=w.rowVersion+1,w.modifiedByUserId=:userId,w.modifiedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE w.id=:workflowId AND w.tenantId=:tenantId AND w.rowVersion=:rowVersion AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenants membership WHERE membership.userId=:authorisedUser AND membership.tenantId=w.tenantId AND membership.isActive=1 AND membership.membershipStatus='active')
